headline: KS Smart Technologies shareholders approve QIP and capital raise
summary: KS Smart Technologies Limited shareholders passed three resolutions approving capital increase, FPI limit hike, and fund raising via QIP/FCCB.

headline: Aikyam Financial to acquire 26% stake in Inani Securities
summary: Aikyam Financial Services Private Limited has filed a public announcement for an open offer to acquire up to 26% equity stake in Inani Securities Limited at ₹60 per share.

headline: Hitachi Energy shareholders approve related party deals
summary: Shareholders of Hitachi Energy India approved material transactions with global Hitachi entities via postal ballot with over 99% support.

headline: Bank of India flags Future Enterprise as fraud account
summary: Bank of India has declared the Future Enterprise Ltd account as fraud, with an outstanding amount of ₹575.40 crore. The bank has made full provision against the exposure.

headline: ICICI AMC Q2 results: net profit at 8.9b rupees
summary: ICICI AMC reported Q2 net profit of 8.9b rupees, up from 8.35b rupees YoY, in line with estimates. Revenue rose to 16.7b rupees from 14.2b rupees YoY.

headline: Azad Engineering wins ₹52.68 crore BHEL contract
summary: Azad Engineering has been awarded a two-year long-term rate contract by BHEL for the supply of critical airfoils, with an estimated contract value of approximately ₹52.68 crore.

headline: Shakti Pumps invests ₹5 crore in EV mobility arm
summary: Shakti Pumps India invested ₹5 crore in its wholly owned subsidiary Shakti EV Mobility Pvt Ltd, bringing total investment in the subsidiary to ₹80 crore.

headline: Stocks to Watch Today: HCLTech, Tata Motors, RBL Bank, Goodluck India in focus
summary: HCLTech rallies on AI partnership, Tata Motors PV surges on JLR recovery, and RBL Bank posts strong Q2 results. Goodluck India jumps 13% on restructuring news.

headline: Kolte Patil Q2FY27 sales hit record ₹1,019 crore
summary: Kolte Patil Developers reported highest-ever quarterly sales of ₹1,019 crore in Q2FY27, up 52% YoY. H1FY27 sales reached ₹1,636 crore, driven by strong Pune launches and Mumbai expansion.

headline: Airfloa Rail wins ₹34.85 crore Vande Bharat contract
summary: Airfloa Rail Technology has secured a ₹34.85 crore contract for designing interiors of the Vande Bharat Sleeper Train, marking a significant order win.

headline: Yash HighVoltage expands US reach to 27 states
summary: Yash HighVoltage has signed a new 36-month agreement, expanding its presence across 27 states in the United States, marking a significant step in its international growth.

headline: Tata Motors and Stellantis to co-develop vehicles globally
summary: Tata Motors and Stellantis plan to collaborate on vehicle development targeting 50+ global markets, combining Tata's technology with Stellantis' engineering capabilities.

headline: Indian rupee opens at 95.17 against the dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 95.17 against the US dollar, compared to the previous close of 95.77, reflecting a stronger opening for the domestic currency.

headline: India's used car market set for 12-15% festive surge
summary: India's second-hand car market is anticipated to rise 12-15% this festive quarter, with organised players possibly growing 25-30%, driven by rural demand, first-time buyers, and rising SUV and luxury car sales.

headline: Avenue Supermarts Q2FY27: EBITDA margin dips 0.28%
summary: Avenue Supermarts reported Q2FY27 EBITDA of ₹1,403 crore, up 14% YoY, but EBITDA margin contracted 0.28% to 7.30%. Analysts have lowered FY27-FY28 earnings projections following missed expectations.

headline: Max India's Antara joins ISB SCALE initiative
summary: Antara Senior Care, a subsidiary of Max India Limited, has joined the SCALE initiative with the Indian School of Business to advance senior-care research and evidence-based models.

headline: Shyam Metalics secures Phutamura coal block
summary: Shyam Metalics invests in Alom Solar to secure mining rights for the Phutamura Coal Block in Chhattisgarh, holding 170 million tonnes of reserves to boost backward integration.

headline: Tonbo Imaging IPO: Pure OFS, No Fresh Issue
summary: Tonbo Imaging files DRHP for a pure Offer for Sale. Revenue fell to ₹3,626 cr in FY26. No proceeds go to the company; all funds go to selling shareholders.

headline: Yuken India appoints Ganesh S S as HR Head
summary: Yuken India Limited appointed Ganesh S S as Head – Human Resources effective October 10, 2026. He brings 16 years of experience in HR operations and industrial relations.

headline: Kotak Mahindra Bank shares flag large-trade signal
summary: A large-trade signal flagged ~5,17,026 Kotak Mahindra Bank shares changing hands on NSE at ₹442.60, with a combined value of ₹22.88 crore.

headline: PFC shares worth ₹635.90 crore change hands
summary: Large trade signal flags PFC shares changing hands across NSE and BSE. Total value approximates ₹635.90 crore at prices near ₹335.

headline: Kotak MF crosses 5% stake in Molbio Diagnostics
summary: Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund acquired 570,000 shares of Molbio Diagnostics, pushing its holding to 5.4834% under SAST regulations.

headline: Mehul Mohanka Trust acquires 99.96% of promoter NFSPL
summary: Mehul Mohanka Benefit Trust acquired 99.96% of Nihal Fiscal Services Private Limited via gift, resulting in indirect acquisition of Tega Industries shares with no change in control.

headline: CIE Automotive India sets Q3FY27 earnings call date
summary: CIE Automotive India Limited announced its Q3FY27 earnings conference call for October 22, 2026. Management will discuss quarterly performance with analysts.

headline: Modi says India's banking system is robust
summary: PM Modi stated that India's banking system is robust compared to numerous other countries, highlighting the relative strength of the nation's financial sector.

headline: Jojo Ltd allots 1:1 bonus shares
summary: Jojo Ltd board approved 1:1 bonus share allotment on Oct 13, 2026. Paid-up capital doubles to ₹68.96 crore. Record date was Oct 12, 2026.

headline: Hindustan Appliances pledges 65.65% equity to CTL
summary: CTL Trusteeship disclosed a pledge of 65,82,000 shares (65.65%) in Hindustan Appliances Ltd to BSE on October 12, 2026.

headline: Schaeffler India shares flag large trade on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,38,971 Schaeffler India shares changing hands on BSE at ₹3,605.20, with a combined value of ₹50.10 crore.

headline: Gabriel shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 199,517 Gabriel shares changing hands on BSE at ₹1412.00, with a combined value of ₹28.17 crore.

headline: DCM Shriram promoter sells 30.94% stake to family
summary: Urvashi Tilakdhar disposed of 2.69 crore equity shares, representing 30.94% of DCM Shriram Fine Chemicals, via an off-market transfer to Alok B Shiram.

headline: Gujjubhai Industries hosts Garba event in Bengaluru
summary: Gujjubhai Industries Limited organised 'Garba with Gujjubhai' in Bengaluru on October 11, 2026. The event showcased Khakhra and Instant Bhel products alongside cultural festivities.

headline: JBCG Advisory raises stake in Centrum Capital
summary: JBCG Advisory Services acquired 1.16 crore shares via warrant exercise, pushing its holding in Centrum Capital to 13.88%. The move increases total voting rights exposure to 17.79%.

headline: GQG Partners cuts Adani Ports stake to 2.77%
summary: GQG Partners LLC disclosed the sale of 98.61 lakh shares of Adani Ports & SEZ, reducing its aggregate holding from 3.20% to 2.77% via open market transactions.

headline: HD Fire Protect IPO Day 1: NII leads at 2.26x
summary: HD Fire Protect IPO opens on Day 1 with overall subscription at 0.81x. NII (sHNI) leads at 2.26x, while QIB participation is yet to begin. Retail at 0.87x.

headline: Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO Day 1: 0.04x
summary: Vaibhav Vyapaar IPO saw sluggish demand on Day 1 with total subscription at 0.04x. Retail led at 0.07x, while QIB interest remained negligible.

headline: Riwind Green Energy board to meet Oct 16 for fund raise
summary: Riwind Green Energy Limited, formerly CMX Holdings, scheduled a board meeting on October 16, 2026, to evaluate raising funds via equity or debt instruments.

headline: Prima Industries CMD S K Gupta passes away
summary: Prima Industries Ltd announced the demise of Chairman and Managing Director S K Gupta on October 13, 2026. The company plans to elect a Pro Tem Chairman.

headline: Puravankara Q2 pre-sales up 62% to ₹2,136 crore
summary: Puravankara reported a 62% YoY rise in Q2FY27 pre-sales to ₹2,136 crore. Collections grew 24%, and the company added ₹14,100 crore GDV pipeline in H1FY27.

headline: Bajaj Finance to host Q2FY27 earnings call on Oct 19
summary: Bajaj Finance will hold its Q2FY27 earnings conference call on October 19, 2026. Senior management including Rajeev Jain will discuss results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Natco Pharma promoter pledges 8.5 lakh shares
summary: V.C. Nannapaneni pledged 8,50,000 Natco Pharma shares to Bajaj Financial Securities. This encumbrance represents 0.47% of total share capital.

headline: 5paisa Capital to host Q2FY27 earnings call Oct 16
summary: 5paisa Capital Limited will announce Q2 FY27 financial results on October 15, 2026. An earnings conference call with analysts is scheduled for October 16, 2026, at 2:00 pm IST.

headline: Mehta Integrated Finance authorises MD for legal settlements
summary: Mehta Integrated Finance Limited authorised its Managing Director to represent the company in legal disputes and execution petitions before courts in Ahmedabad.

headline: Machhar Industries secures ₹41.97 lakh vehicle loan
summary: Machhar Industries Ltd entered a vehicle loan agreement with HDFC Bank for ₹41.97 lakh. The facility is secured by hypothecation of a BYD Sealion 7 EV.

headline: Fusion CX IPO: ₹1,818 Cr Revenue; AI-Driven CX Leader
summary: Fusion CX Ltd, a global CX and BPO provider, reports ₹1,818.14 Cr FY2026 revenue. IPO proceeds target debt repayment and AI upgrades.

headline: Kotak Bank block trade: ~7,01,639 shares at ₹439.20
summary: A block trade of ~7,01,639 shares of Kotak Mahindra Bank was executed on the NSE at ₹439.20 per share, aggregating to ₹30.82 crore.

headline: Aar Shyam open offer at ₹15/share
summary: Radha Krishna Avudari and others launch open offer for 26% equity in Aar Shyam India Investment Company Ltd at ₹15 per share, seeking control via preferential allotment and SPA.

headline: Jyoti Ltd listing application rejected by BSE
summary: BSE rejected Jyoti Ltd's listing application for 59.63 lakh shares. Appeals to SAT and Supreme Court were dismissed, leaving shares unlisted despite shareholder ratification.

headline: Infosys Springboard hits 2.5 lakh job offers
summary: Infosys Foundation's Springboard Livelihood Program enabled over 2.5 lakh job offers, reaching the halfway mark toward its 2030 goal of 5 lakh opportunities.

headline: BSE grants in-principle approval for Chandra Bhagat Pharma warrants
summary: BSE has granted in-principle approval to Chandra Bhagat Pharma for issuing 66 lakh convertible warrants at ₹44 per share. The issue targets promoters and non-promoters on a preferential basis.

headline: NTPC in green ammonia talks with Japan, South Korea, Germany
summary: NTPC is in discussions with buyers from Japan, South Korea, and Germany for green ammonia deals as it develops a green hydrogen hub in Andhra Pradesh to produce green ammonia and methanol for export.

headline: Supreme Court rejects MMTC's NSEL settlement challenge
summary: The Supreme Court dismissed MMTC's challenge to the ₹31,950 crore National Spot Exchange settlement, upholding the earlier ruling against the state-owned trading company.

headline: PNB Gilts turns profitable in Q2
summary: PNB Gilts reported a net profit of ₹448 million in Q2, swinging from a loss of ₹454 million last year, despite a slight dip in revenue to ₹4.34 billion.

headline: Kotak Bank sees ₹76.86 crore block trade on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 1,752,557 shares of Kotak Mahindra Bank was executed on the BSE at ₹438.55 per share, totalling ₹76.86 crore.

headline: Sobha Ltd to host Q2FY27 analyst call Oct 19
summary: Sobha Limited will conduct a conference call on October 19, 2026, to discuss Q2 and H1 FY27 financial performance. MD Jagadish Nangineni and CFO Yogesh Bansal will present.

headline: Bagmane REIT sponsor holding at 82.81%
summary: Bagmane Prime Office REIT reports Q2FY27 unitholding pattern. Sponsor group holds 82.81% of units, while public holding stands at 17.19%.

headline: Eimco Elecon Q2 revenue jumps 71% to ₹568 million
summary: Eimco Elecon reported a 71% YoY rise in Q2 revenue to ₹568 million. EBITDA margin expanded to 18.91%, and net profit grew to ₹78 million.

headline: Bandhan Bank unaware of IHC stake purchase
summary: Bandhan Bank stated it has no knowledge of Abu Dhabi's IHC acquiring a stake in the bank. The stock price rose in line with broader market trends, with no significant impact on the bank.

headline: NPCI to introduce UPI MDR for merchants after Diwali
summary: NPCI plans to levy Merchant Discount Rate on specific person-to-merchant UPI transactions post-Diwali. Exact implementation date to be announced soon.

headline: Yasho Industries shareholders approve borrowing limit hike
summary: Yasho Industries Ltd members approved enhancing borrowing limits to ₹1,250 crore and continuing director commissions via postal ballot.

headline: Quest Flow Wins SIDM Award for Navy Valves
summary: Quest Flow Controls wins SIDM Champion Award 2026 for indigenously manufacturing critical valves for Indian Navy warships and submarines, replacing imports.

headline: Info Edge approves ₹200 crore investment in subsidiaries
summary: Info Edge (India) Ltd board approved ₹200 crore total investment in two wholly owned subsidiaries, Startup Internet Services and Startup Investments, to fund future opportunities.

headline: Adani Energy to host 1HFY27 results call
summary: Adani Energy Solutions will hold an investor call on October 23, 2026, to discuss unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Vaswani Industries gets BSE, NSE nod for preferential issue
summary: Vaswani Industries received in-principle approval from BSE and NSE to issue 16.45 lakh shares at ₹60 each to promoters. The move complies with SEBI regulations.

headline: Pavna Industries sells 50.74% stake in subsidiary
summary: Pavna Industries completed the sale of its entire 50.74% equity stake in Pavna Auto Engineering Private Limited to a promoter group member for ₹8.79 crore.

headline: Puravankara executive announces six upcoming project launches
summary: A Puravankara executive has announced plans to launch six upcoming projects, signalling an active pipeline for the real estate developer.

headline: JTL Industries gets CPWD approval for steel pipes
summary: JTL Industries has received approval from the Central Public Works Department (CPWD) for its steel pipes and hollow sections, marking a key regulatory milestone.

headline: Infosys sees ₹515.95 crore block trade on BSE
summary: A block trade worth ₹515.95 crore was executed on BSE for approximately 4,900,000 Infosys shares at a price of ₹1,052.95 per share.

headline: Rishabh Digha Steel EGM to appoint new auditors
summary: Rishabh Digha Steel & Allied Products schedules an EGM on November 5, 2026, to appoint S.D. Jain & Company as statutory auditors following the resignation of Bilimoria Mehta & Co.

headline: GP Petroleums to acquire stake in Pipavav terminal
summary: GP Petroleums Ltd board approved acquiring equity shares in Incubit Pipavav Terminal Private Limited for ₹44.27 crore to strengthen operational presence.

headline: VIP Clothing clarifies share pledge release
summary: VIP Clothing Ltd clarified a disclosure error regarding Mrs. Lalita Pathare's pledge release. The filing confirms 6,00,000 shares were released on September 25, 2026.

headline: Mangalam Global opens NEAT EVERYDAY store in Ahmedabad
summary: Mangalam Global Enterprise Ltd inaugurated a new NEAT EVERYDAY retail store in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, on October 13, 2026. This expansion strengthens its nutraceutical and wellness retail footprint.

headline: Prestige Estates posts ₹1.38 lakh crore H1 pre-sales
summary: Prestige Estates Projects Ltd reported H1FY27 pre-sales of ₹1,38,043 million, up 20% YoY in Q2. The company secured a ₹30,000 million investment from CPP Investments for its hospitality arm.

headline: Popees Baby Care seeks promoter reclassification
summary: Popees Baby Care India Ltd applied to BSE for reclassifying promoters Jugalkishore and Sunita Maniyar to Public category under SEBI regulations.

headline: Finance Ministry open to views on LTCG removal
summary: The Finance Ministry has said it will keenly hear views on the removal of Long Term Capital Gains tax, signalling openness to stakeholder feedback on the subject.

headline: Tata Power signs MoU with Imperial College London
summary: Tata Power and Imperial College London signed an MoU to collaborate on next-generation energy systems, focusing on grid flexibility, storage, and AI.

headline: Aarti Industries signs long-term supply deal worth ₹1,500 crore
summary: Aarti Industries has signed a long-term manufacturing and supply agreement with a global specialty chemical firm, with expected revenue of around ₹1,500 crore from the deal.

headline: Persistent Systems opens third Hyderabad facility
summary: Persistent Systems has inaugurated its third facility in Hyderabad, aimed at expanding its AI and modernization services capabilities in the region.

headline: HEG Graphite name changed to HEG Limited
summary: HEG Graphite Limited has officially changed its name to HEG Limited effective October 12, 2026 following approval from the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.

headline: Maxgrow India acquires 74% stake in Hurricane Windfarms
summary: Maxgrow India Limited acquired a 74% stake in Hurricane Windfarms Private Limited for ₹525 per share. The target entity reported a turnover of ₹269.12 lakh for FY26.
